messages:
Marco: Heads up — ran the quant4b bring-up with the new promptbank weights and saw a ~6% drop on our longform recall metric in the nightly eval. not on all models, mostly when we upsampleed 'edge-instruction' cohort.
Asha: Ugh. Is the hit in fp16 or only in int4 sim?
Marco: Both, but larger in int4. eval diff attached in the bot summary below. looks correlated with the upsample change from yesterday.
Dmitri: Can you paste the sampling change? I want to see exact weight delta.
Marco: Sure — snippet:
```
# sampling config
cohorts:
  base: 0.85
  edge-instruction: 0.12  # previously 0.02
  rare-qa: 0.03
```
Marco: We intentionally bumped edge-instruction to exercise more long-context reasoning.
Sophie: Was the holdout curated/golden updated too? if edge got more traffic we might be leaking similar signals into golden.
Marco: No golden refresh yet. We just changed live sampling for labeler queue.
labeling-bot: nightly-eval | model: quant4b-int4 | metric: longform_recall | baseline: 0.812 -> new: 0.763 | delta: -0.049 | affected_cohort: edge-instruction
Jen: Quick mitigation: can we 1) revert sampling to previous weights for a day, 2) run a targeted canary where we replay a small batch through fp16 + int4 with the new prompts, and 3) schedule a micro-golden relabel for 500 edge samples?
Asha: +1 to Jen's plan. Also add a diff checklist: tokenization regens, kvcache prefix length change, and prompt-truncation behavior. Those often amplify quant noise.
Dmitri: I'll run the replay. command I'll use: `python tools/replay_eval.py --ids edge-cohort-2026-03-20 --models quant4b-int4,fp16 --out /tmp/replay.csv`
Sophie: Labeling capacity wise — we can spin up a small adjudication pool. tagging it as micro-golden and prioritizing edge-instruction. estimate 2 humans, 3 hours to do 500 examples.
Marco: OK I'll revert sampling now and start the canary replay. tagging @Dmitri for results and @Sophie for labeling.
Jen: If replay reproduces the delta in int4 but not fp16, we should add a targeted quant-smoke to the onboarding checklist: compare logits/topk and a small attribution check.
Marco: Noted. Also planning to run a lightweight cluster-diff: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` + env-export to correlate infra changes.
labeling-bot: micro-golden-task created | id: MG-3542 | cohort: edge-instruction | size: 500 | due: 2026-03-21T16:00Z
Dmitri: Replay started (job 5467). Will post metrics in this thread when done.
Sophie: I'll claim MG-3542 and post progress. thanks. :raised_hands:
Marco: thx team. prefer quick rollback to stable sampling, run canary, then decide whether golden needs refresh or just relabel subset. keep this thread for updates only.
Dmitri: Replay done. preliminary: int4 delta -0.052, fp16 delta -0.011. attaching short CSV to the infra artifact store.
Marco: That looks like quant amplification. Sophie — please prioritize adjudication on MG-3542 for disagreements where answer variants diverge.
Sophie: On it. starting now. will ping when 50% done.
Jen: Post-mortem action items (short): 1) add quant-sensitivity step to model bring-up checklist, 2) add canary replay to sampling changes, 3) schedule golden-refresh policy discussion next week.
Marco: Agreed. I'll open a GH issue and link the replay artifacts + labeling results once Sophie finishes.
Sophie: 50% done — seeing a lot of phrasing variance, not outright hallucination. many labels are semantically equivalent but scored differently by our metrics. marking those for consensus adjudication.
Dmitri: Replay final metrics pushed to infra. Will also run a per-token logit variance probe tomorrow.
labeling-bot: micro-golden-task MG-3542 marked 100% complete by Sophie and team. adjudications: 42/500 needed consensus.
Marco: Excellent. once adjudication CSV is up I'll run an eval with adjudicated gold and report. If delta shrinks --> sampling caused evaluation leakage/artifacts; if not --> quant kernel issue.
Jen: keep the rollout halted for this model variant until we have adjudicated eval and the per-token probe. :white_check_mark:
Marco: Will do. closing for now — will update with GH link.
